export.description: vector exports follow the current preview exactly, including guides, typography, and placeholders. json exports preserve the editable project document.
export.subject: subject
export.author: author

feedback.title: f e e d b a c k
feedback.commentPlaceholder: describe the issue, idea, or workflow problem.
feedback.sent: thank you. your feedback has been sent.
feedback.invalidScreenshotType: {name} is not a png, jpeg, or webp image.
feedback.logColumnMissing: feedback log column is missing. run the support_log sql migration in supabase, then try again.
feedback.screenshotStorageMissing: feedback screenshot storage is missing. run the feedback_screenshots sql migration in supabase, then try again.
feedback.screenshotStorageAmbiguous: feedback screenshot storage failed because the supabase rpc has an ambiguous sql parameter. replace the add_feedback_screenshot function with the corrected version.
feedback.policyRejected: feedback could not be sent because the supabase insert policy rejected it.
feedback.attachmentLimit: feedback could not be sent because an attachment exceeds the supabase limits.
feedback.submitFailed: feedback could not be sent. check supabase configuration or try again later.

account.title: a c c o u n t
account.conflictMessage: the active project changed locally and in the cloud. choose which copy should win.

interactionHints.edit: hover a layer and click the edit icon to edit.
interactionHints.createParagraph: double-click empty area to create paragraph.
interactionHints.createImage: shift-double-click empty module to create image placeholder.
interactionHints.duplicate: use + to duplicate, also across pages • shift-drag baseline snap (overset).

notices.deletedFromCloudMessage: the selected user layout was removed from the local library and soft-deleted in supabase. cloud status: deleted in cloud.
notices.deletedLocallyQueuedMessage: the selected user layout was removed from the local library and will be deleted from supabase the next time cloud sync is available. cloud status: delete queued.
notices.deletedFromUsersMessage: the selected user layout was removed from the local library. cloud status: no cloud copy.
notices.exportFailedPresetMessage: could not open export for the selected preset.
notices.savedToLibrarySignedInMessage: project stored in the local users library. signed-in layouts sync to the cloud automatically.
notices.savedToLibrarySignedOutMessage: project stored in the local users library. sign in to sync saved layouts to the cloud.
notices.librarySaveFailedMessage: could not store the project in the local library.
notices.conflictResolvedMessage: the local project will overwrite the cloud copy on the next successful sync.
notices.conflictResolutionFailedMessage: could not resolve the active project conflict. check the cloud activity log and try again.
notices.conflictCloudLoadFailedMessage: could not load the cloud copy for the active project.
notices.cloudCopyRestoredMessage: the active project now uses the cloud copy and is marked synced locally.
notices.conflictDeletedCloudMessage: the conflicted project was removed locally and soft-deleted in supabase.
notices.conflictDeleteQueuedMessage: the conflicted project was removed locally and will be soft-deleted in supabase when cloud sync is available.
notices.conflictDeletedLocallyMessage: the conflicted local project was removed from the users library.

gridReduction.columns: cannot reduce columns: some paragraphs or image placeholders are positioned beyond the new grid size. reposition or delete them first.
gridReduction.rows: cannot reduce rows: some paragraphs or image placeholders would fall outside the new grid. reposition or delete them first.
gridReduction.grid: cannot reduce the grid: some paragraphs or image placeholders would fall outside the new grid. reposition or delete them first.

auth.signOutFailed: could not sign out of the cloud account.
auth.sessionRestoreFailed: could not restore the cloud session.
auth.verifyCodeFailed: could not verify the sign-in code.
auth.sendCodeFailed: could not send the sign-in code.
auth.authUnavailable: cloud auth is unavailable. check the supabase url and anon key in the local environment.
auth.emailRequired: enter an email address before requesting a sign-in code.
auth.codeRequired: enter the six-digit sign-in code from your email.
auth.codeInvalid: this sign-in code is invalid or expired. request a new code and try again.
auth.rateLimit: too many sign-in codes were requested. wait a moment and try again. if this keeps happening, check the supabase auth rate limits and smtp setup.
auth.signOutUnavailable: supabase is temporarily unavailable and could not complete sign-out. wait a moment and try again.
auth.sessionUnavailable: supabase is temporarily unavailable and the cloud session could not be restored right now. wait a moment and try again.
auth.verifyUnavailable: supabase is temporarily unavailable and could not verify the sign-in code. wait a moment and try again.
auth.sendUnavailable: supabase is temporarily unavailable and could not send the sign-in code. wait a moment and try again.
auth.emailNotAllowed: this email address is not allowed by the current supabase mail configuration. check the smtp sender setup or authorized test addresses.
auth.redirectNotAllowed: this sign-in redirect is not allowed. check supabase authentication url configuration for the current app origin.
auth.signOutNetwork: could not reach supabase to sign out. check the network connection and try again.
auth.sessionNetwork: could not reach supabase to restore the cloud session. check the network connection and try again.
auth.network: could not reach supabase. check the network connection and the configured project url, then try again.
auth.signOutWithRaw: could not sign out of the cloud account. supabase said: {message}
auth.sessionWithRaw: could not restore the cloud session. supabase said: {message}
auth.verifyWithRaw: could not verify the sign-in code. supabase said: {message}
auth.sendWithRaw: could not send the sign-in code. supabase said: {message}

cloud.conflictMessage: the local project and the cloud copy changed at the same time. the local project was kept and marked as conflicted.
cloud.sessionExpiredMessage: the cloud session is no longer valid. sign in again to resume sync.
cloud.permissionsMessage: cloud sync is blocked by supabase permissions. check the projects table rls policies and the storage bucket policies.
cloud.storageMissingMessage: the `project-archives` storage bucket is missing or inaccessible. check the bucket name and storage policies in supabase.
cloud.databaseMissingMessage: the supabase `projects` table or its expected columns are missing. run the sql setup for the cloud project store again.
cloud.rateLimitMessage: supabase temporarily refused more cloud requests. wait a moment and try again.
cloud.serviceUnavailableMessage: supabase is temporarily unavailable. local changes remain safe in dexie and will sync when the service recovers.
cloud.offlineMessage: could not reach supabase. local changes remain in dexie and can sync when the connection returns.
